weekend_note: Chilly but no rain is listed for the weekend: Friday high 64, Saturday only 58, Sunday 61, with lows from 42 to 48. Rain returns Monday (40%). Picks: Festa Italiana (Fri-Sat), Bands on the Bayou, the Fall Food Truck Fest and Launch's grand opening (Sat), then EggFest (Sun), all outdoors except Launch, so bundle up. White Tie Rock at the ballpark Friday night is a good evening option, and the Ice Flyers play at the Bay Center Friday and Saturday. Monday's free Florida Vibe softball welcome falls on the wetter day.
